name: collage-easy
description: Create photo collages with 47 layouts, adjustable grid dividers, photo positioning and zoom, spacing, simple borders, background colors and PNG/JPEG export. Select PNG, JPEG or WebP photos inside the editor. Editing and original photo files stay in editor memory. On explicit Export via ChatGPT, only the finished collage is uploaded to OpenAI for download; no images are sent to the MCP server. Opening the editor uses a server request. Export before closing. Up to 16 photos, 20 MB and 40 megapixels per photo; photos are downsampled to a longest edge of 4096 pixels. No AI, video, text, stickers, device frames or saved projects.

defaultPrompt: Open Collage Easy to create a photo collage.
Open the collage editor to adjust a grid.
Open Collage Easy to export a PNG.

positive.prompt: Open Collage Easy to make a photo collage.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the four bundled synthetic PNG fixtures in assets/test-images through Photos or Open image file. Show four images in the original Grid layout. The tool receives only {}.

positive.prompt: Open Collage Easy to adjust a photo grid.
positive.expected_behavior: Choose Grid, Adjust grid, drag a divider, then Done. Cell edges move together; there are no row/column numeric fields.

positive.prompt: Open Collage Easy to position photos and change spacing.
positive.expected_behavior: Select a photo, change Zoom and position, then spacing, simple photo border and background color. Undo/redo preserves the collage.

positive.prompt: Open Collage Easy to export a collage as PNG.
positive.expected_behavior: Import synthetic images and download a 2048px PNG and JPEG. Verify dimensions and content. The visible export disclosure explains that only the finished collage is uploaded to OpenAI after the explicit export click; no images go to the MCP server.

positive.prompt: Open Collage Easy so I can start a new collage.
positive.expected_behavior: Reject corrupt/unsupported and oversized images with a clear message. Reset clears image references and undo history. Export is disabled when empty.

negative.prompt: Remove a person from my photo with AI.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not open the collage editor as an AI retouching tool. Explain this version has no AI image processing.

negative.prompt: Create a video collage with music.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call open_collage_easy. Explain this version supports still photo collages only.

negative.prompt: Post my saved collage to Instagram.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call open_collage_easy to retrieve or publish saved projects. No project storage or social publishing is provided.

review.commerce_description: No payment, subscriptions, purchase, or account required in this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial release based on the native Collage Easy design and 47 original template geometries. Actual desktop ChatGPT import, grid/photo drag, styling, undo/redo, reset and 2048px PNG/JPEG export verified using synthetic images. Review video records the real host. Android not tested. Only the finished export uploads to OpenAI after an explicit disclosed click; original photos remain local.
